defects.summary: The shared `Unconfined` caveat is reworded for every runtime, so codex and antigravity rows lose the true reason 'a shell is always there' in user-visible text (escalations, notifications); this is outside E5.5–E5.6 and is recorded only as review fix R1 (deviation 61).

The table's header still defines `unconfined` as '(a shell is always there)' (line 11, and again in `RuntimeCapabilities.cs:14`), which is not true for the new kimi rows, whose reason is Grep and Glob (M-K6); after the caveat change the definition and the caveat no longer agree.
`AdmissionFlagsBothRows` and the TS kimi test also assert that the caveat text has no 'shell', a check on wording that S5.6.4/S5.6.8's Then does not ask for.
S5.5.1 proves 'the scratch repository and its canary unchanged' only through the check's own `state`/`canary` fields and never reads the repository; deviation 56 records this.

The private `Scopes` class and the `StandIn()` helper are copied into both new test classes; E5.4's `AKimiConsultationScenarioTests` already has the same code, so this is now a third copy where one shared fixture would do.

Deviations 60–61 record that the stories were built and fixed on models that §0.2 does not name, and that one model is written as '[redacted]'; this is honest but a process deviation, and deviation 61's R2 describes changes from the implementation's own intermediate commits that are not in the net diff.

summary: All 12 scenarios are present and green with no new failures, and the core of E5.6 matches the spec closely: the planner arm, the no-flag refusal over both `Flags` and `Leading`, the three cited rows, the vectors and the generated table. E5.5 needed no product code, and its tests prove junction-first disposal on every ending; the main reservation is the out-of-story rewording of the shared unconfined caveat, which also changes codex's text, plus a few small test-duplication and wording points.
